title: Motion Sensor Aapko Dekhta Nahi! PIR Sensor Kaise Kaam Karta Hai? 🤔 #shorts
description:
Light apne aap jal jaati hai — par sensor aapko dekh hi nahi sakta! PIR motion sensor sirf chalti hui garmi (body heat) mehsoos karta hai.
🔥 Aapka shareer infrared mein chamakta hai (~37°C, ~10 µm)
🔍 Fresnel lens kamre ko zones mein baant'ta hai
⚡ Chip ke do hisse — pehle A garam, phir B
📈 Farak ki lehar threshold paar kare → output HIGH → MOTION!
🔁 Aise hi aur "kaise kaam karta hai" videos ke liye subscribe karein
